usageNotes: Deletes an SDN zone configuration object from the cluster. The zone must have no VNets assigned to it before deletion — removing a zone that still has dependent VNets will fail. Requires the `SDN.Allocate` privilege on the `/sdn/zones/{zone}` path, and changes must be applied to the running SDN configuration afterward via the SDN apply endpoint.
destructiveReason: Permanently removes the SDN zone configuration object; any network segmentation, routing policy, or VNet associations that depended on this zone must be reconfigured manually.
tips: SDN changes are staged — after deleting the zone, call the SDN apply endpoint (PUT /cluster/sdn) to push the change to all nodes.
If the global SDN config is locked, supply the `lock-token` param to unlock and proceed in one step.
Zone identifiers are 2–8 alphanumeric characters starting with a letter; verify the exact ID with get_cluster_sdn_zones before deleting.
Check for dependent VNets first using list_cluster_sdn_vnets; deletion will be rejected if any VNet still references this zone.
